hero.lead: I'm Alejandro — a software developer, mathematician, and AI specialist based in Medellín, Colombia. I work on the intersection of machine learning, Web3, and everyday web software.

quote: Most of what's worth building requires both the mathematician's patience and the engineer's restlessness. I try to keep both in the room.

journey.p: A non-linear walk through mathematics, teaching, and software.

timeline.title: AI Engineer · Independent consultant
timeline.desc: Lead engineer of Aluna, an AI recruitment platform: Next.js and FastAPI, durable analysis pipelines on Inngest and multi-model routing with LiteLLM.

timeline.title: AI Specialist
timeline.desc: Built an AI educational content generator with LangChain, LangGraph and n8n, and a Digital Professor that explains course content in real-time conversation.

timeline.title: Independent Software & AI Consultant
timeline.desc: Led the engineering of CREARIA's multi-tenant AI support agent on WhatsApp, email and Instagram.

timeline.title: Full Stack Engineer
timeline.desc: Developed AI avatar systems, real-time video pipelines, and open-source tooling with Python, React, and Three.js.

timeline.title: Full Stack Engineer
timeline.desc: Built blockchain-based platforms and scalable web applications with Django, Node.js, React, Solidity and AWS.

timeline.title: Professor (part-time)
timeline.desc: Taught mathematics, linear algebra, and calculus. Mentored students in mathematical modeling and computational thinking.

items.title: Understand before you build
items.desc: Every hour spent sharpening the problem statement saves a week of code. I'd rather ship the second draft of the right thing than the first draft of the wrong one.

items.title: Small surfaces, clear edges
items.desc: Complex systems are made of simple parts with well-chosen boundaries. If a component is hard to name, it's usually doing too much.

items.title: Write like you're explaining to yourself
items.desc: Code, essays, and docs all reward the same instinct: assume a reader who is smart, distracted, and a little tired.

items.title: Writing
items.desc: A slow series on RAG systems, aimed at engineers who want the real story.

items.title: Building
items.desc: A small product with a friend. Details later.

items.title: Teaching
items.desc: Topofilosofía — a 10-week cohort on topology from the ground up.

items.title: Reading
items.desc: Cal Newport's Slow Productivity, papers on attention mechanisms, and Borges.
Open source, experiments, and a few things I wish I'd pushed sooner.
